# Will a rental-arbitrage unit earn back its furniture before the lease ends?

> Free rental arbitrage calculator: rent, utilities, furnishing, nightly rate, occupancy, commission and turnovers become monthly profit, break-even occupancy, the month furnishing is earned back and what the lease nets. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/str-arbitrage-lease-calculator/)
